noteZh: 曲线是由实测光谱取得的光学常数 k（无量纲），不是吸光度 A 或透过率 T。请核对每个样本的相态与温度。标注是独立解释层；窄带位置取所选区间的原始 k 最大值，宽带只解释包络。不同样本峰高不能直接比较浓度。官能团区间不是唯一鉴定规则。

samples.readingIntroZh: 样品是液态苯乙烯低聚物；先看芳香 C–H，再看环骨架和低波数指纹。

features.explanationZh: 观察略高于 3000 cm⁻¹ 的峰：支持芳香 C–H 伸缩。再找环骨架和面外振动，不凭它判断所有芳香结构。

features.assignmentSource: Published polystyrene vibrational assignment; qualified fingerprint interpretation

features.explanationZh: 这处峰支持芳环骨架振动。与约 1490 cm⁻¹ 的另一环带一起看，形成比单峰更有力的芳香族线索。
features.observedKind: local maximum of raw k within selected window
features.assignmentSource: Published polystyrene vibrational assignment; qualified fingerprint interpretation

features.explanationZh: 观察这处环骨架特征，并与约 1600 cm⁻¹ 的峰配对。环振动有耦合，不宜简单描述为一条独立 C=C 键。
features.observedKind: local maximum of raw k within selected window
features.assignmentSource: Published polystyrene vibrational assignment; qualified fingerprint interpretation

features.explanationZh: 低波数强峰可为单取代芳环的 C–H 面外振动提供指纹线索。要与约 700 cm⁻¹ 及上方环带联合验证。
features.observedKind: local maximum of raw k within selected window
features.assignmentSource: Published polystyrene vibrational assignment; qualified fingerprint interpretation

features.explanationZh: 与约 750 cm⁻¹ 的带一起读：这组面外振动支持单取代芳环指纹。液态低聚物谱不能当作固态薄膜的校准证书。
features.observedKind: local maximum of raw k within selected window
features.assignmentSource: Published polystyrene vibrational assignment; qualified fingerprint interpretation

features.explanationZh: 这里还可见脂肪族 C–H 伸缩，反映低聚物的碳氢骨架。与芳香 C–H 对比，认识一个样品可同时有多类振动。

samples.readingIntroZh: 先看末端乙烯基的成对面外带，再核对 C=C 与芳环；这是单体，不是液态低聚物谱。

features.labelZh: 乙烯基 C=C 伸缩区
features.explanationZh: 这里的带支持与苯环共轭的乙烯基 C=C 伸缩。位置会受共轭影响；先与末端 =CH₂ 面外带联合，不单凭这一带认定烯烃。
features.observedKind: local maximum of raw k within selected window
features.assignmentSource: Official university functional-group correlation reference; approximate, qualified interpretation

features.labelZh: 末端 =CH₂ 面外带：高波数侧
features.explanationZh: 约 990 cm⁻¹ 的带可与约 910 cm⁻¹ 的带成对支持末端乙烯基。指纹区可能耦合；要联合 C=C 和 =C–H 区域读谱。
features.observedKind: local maximum of raw k within selected window
features.assignmentSource: Official university functional-group correlation reference; approximate, qualified interpretation

features.labelZh: 末端 =CH₂ 面外带：低波数侧
features.explanationZh: 与约 990 cm⁻¹ 的带一起观察，支持 R–CH=CH₂ 的面外振动组合。不能把一个低波数指纹峰当作唯一物质鉴定。
features.observedKind: local maximum of raw k within selected window
features.assignmentSource: Official university functional-group correlation reference; approximate, qualified interpretation

features.labelZh: sp² C–H 伸缩区（烯基 / 芳香重叠）
features.explanationZh: 一组峰支持 sp² C–H 伸缩；苯乙烯同时含烯基和芳环，二者可重叠。不要把本区最大值全部归给烯基，需再看低波数组合。
features.observedKind: local maximum of raw k within selected window
features.assignmentSource: Official university functional-group correlation reference; approximate, qualified interpretation

features.explanationZh: 这里的芳环骨架带说明同一单体还有苯环。与乙烯基特征分开联合观察，不能把苯乙烯与聚苯乙烯低聚物视作同一个样品。
features.observedKind: local maximum of raw k within selected window
features.assignmentSource: Official university functional-group correlation reference; approximate, qualified interpretation

samples.limitationZh: 这是液态苯乙烯单体；供应商添加 4-tert-butylcatechol 稳定剂。与液态苯乙烯低聚物（polystyrene）是不同样品。

samples.labelZh: 丙炔（8 K 非晶固体）
samples.readingIntroZh: 这是 8 K 非晶丙炔的实测 k 谱；先看端炔 ≡C–H，再读较弱的 C≡C 与弯曲带。

features.explanationZh: 先看约 3280 cm⁻¹ 的端炔 C–H 带。这里是 8 K 非晶固体，位置和宽度不代表室温气体或液体；再结合 C≡C 与弯曲区。
features.observedKind: local maximum of raw k within selected window
features.assignmentSource: Hudson et al. 2021, Table 8 (amorphous propyne at 8 K); approximate assignments separate from measured k array

features.explanationZh: 这处较弱带与论文给出的 C≡C 伸缩相符。三键伸缩可因对称性而很弱或不活跃，不能从缺少强峰否定炔键；本样本须与端炔 C–H 联合判断。
features.observedKind: local maximum of raw k within selected window
features.assignmentSource: Hudson et al. 2021, Table 8 (amorphous propyne at 8 K); approximate assignments separate from measured k array

features.explanationZh: 这里的带可含丙炔 C–H 弯曲贡献，论文归属为近似模式描述。与端炔伸缩和 C≡C 一起读，指纹区通常包含耦合。
features.observedKind: local maximum of raw k within selected window
features.assignmentSource: Hudson et al. 2021, Table 8 (amorphous propyne at 8 K); approximate assignments separate from measured k array

features.explanationZh: 低波数这一带支持端炔 C–H 弯曲。先对照高波数 ≡C–H 伸缩，再联合较弱 C≡C；非晶固体的带形不可套成所有端炔的固定规则。
features.observedKind: local maximum of raw k within selected window
features.assignmentSource: Hudson et al. 2021, Table 8 (amorphous propyne at 8 K); approximate assignments separate from measured k array

metadata.source: NASA Goddard Cosmic Ice Laboratory, C3 hydrocarbon optical constants (2021 publication)

measurement.mode: Imaginary refractive index derived by publisher from normal-incidence transmission FTIR measurements and optical-constants analysis
measurement.instrument: FTIR; paper identifies Thermo iS50 for phase checks; selected workbook does not separately name the optical-constants acquisition instrument
measurement.conditionsZh: 8 K 非晶固体；气相沉积在预冷 CsI 或 KBr 基底，正入射透射 FTIR 后由作者计算光学常数。不是室温液体谱。
measurement.substrate: CsI or KBr; selected workbook block does not specify which substrate
measurement.thicknessNote: Paper reports multiple ice thicknesses ~0.25–2 µm for intensity measurements. No unique thickness assigned to this optical-constants workbook block.
measurement.resolutionNote: ~0.0603 cm^-1 source grid spacing is not the 0.5 cm^-1 instrumental resolution.
measurement.publisherProcessing: Optical constants derived by publisher from measured transmission spectra using updated iterative optical-constants analysis with substrate effects and refractive-index measurements. Source contains negative baseline/numerical-processing values, which are retained and do not represent physical negative absorption.
measurement.knownContaminants: Paper reports small features from ~0.1% CO2 at 2338 cm^-1 and ~1% allene at 1948 cm^-1 in amorphous propyne; no peaks are removed here.

processing.noteZh: 保留作者从透射实验导出的原始 k 列，包括源文件中的负基线/数值处理值；这些数值不表示物理上的负吸收，不能裁零、补峰或改标为透过率。
